claims.statement: Directive (EU) 2020/2184 requires domestic-distribution risk analysis and proportionate Legionella measures, with monitoring focus permitted for priority premises.
Polish rules and sanitary guidance require Legionella monitoring in relevant healthcare, public-use and collective-residence hot-water systems and require approved or accredited laboratory testing.

Polish sanitary authorities reported 6695 Legionella tests in 2024 with 1286 poor hot-water-system results (19%), including exceedances at 20% of tested healthcare premises and 15% of tested lodging premises.
ECDC reported a 2024 EU/EEA notification rate of 3.4 Legionnaires' disease cases per 100000, up from 3.2 in 2023.
Laboratory results require system-specific expert interpretation; a negative sample is not a guarantee of absence and analytics cannot replace the building risk assessment or control plan.

Laboratory portals and specialist Legionella platforms already advertise trend analysis, dashboards and portfolio reporting, so differentiation must come from lab-channel deployment and comparable-building outcome benchmarks.

contrary_evidence: Eurofins already offers water-result portals with data intelligence and trend analysis.
LegionellaDossier reports broad installed use and offers historical trends, dashboards and non-compliance management.
Official guidance says samples alone are an imperfect proxy and need competent system-specific interpretation.

economics.acquisition_route: Recruit one multi-site hotel operator and one contracted competent water-safety professional for a secure-upload paid pilot; seek introductions from accredited laboratories or water-safety consultants without requiring a portal integration, and add a connector only after contribution payback is demonstrated.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Planning logic, not validation: revenue becomes active hotel portfolios multiplied by an unvalidated annual workflow fee plus lab-confirmed remediation cases multiplied by an unvalidated case fee. This replaces dependence on 100000 low-priced sample events with a smaller number of higher-value closed-loop workflows. Founder net worth above 5 million PLN still requires demonstrated renewals, positive contribution after expert and support costs, sufficient portfolio scale, sustained profit and retained founder control; no price, volume, margin or valuation is assumed.
economics.founder_time: About 3 founder hours daily on product, data workflow and pilot operations; accredited laboratories retain sampling and result authority, contracted competent experts own risk interpretation and control decisions, and hotel staff or their contractors execute interventions.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unknown; validate contribution after contracted expert review, secure hosting, support, referral or channel cost and any liability insurance. Do not assume the prior 60-70% planning range.
economics.payback: Unknown; each paid remediation-case pilot must cover its incremental onboarding, expert-review and support costs, and no laboratory connector is built until cumulative gross profit demonstrably covers it.
economics.pricing: No price is assumed. Test a paid per-remediation-case fee and an optional annual multi-site workflow subscription; willingness to pay is unknown.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Potential repeat use comes from each lab-confirmed positive-to-retest episode and annual portfolio oversight. Renewal is unproven and depends on operators valuing coordinated evidence and an audit-ready case dossier.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Only records covered by explicit operator reuse rights feed a structured hotel-system dataset linking context, expert-signed actions and accredited retest outcomes; no rights or resulting advantage are assumed before contracting
fingerprint.customer: Multi-site hotel operators managing comparable domestic hot-water systems
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Direct secure-upload pilot with multi-site hotel operators, introduced where possible by accredited laboratories or competent water-safety consultants; no portal integration is required initially
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Expert-governed positive-result-to-accredited-retest evidence workflow sold per remediation case plus an optional portfolio subscription; it does not issue laboratory results or control decisions
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The hotel operator pays when a lab-confirmed positive-result remediation case is activated, with an optional annual portfolio workflow subscription
fingerprint.problem_trigger: An accredited laboratory reports a Legionella exceedance in a participating hotel and a remediation-to-retest case must be governed

founder_fit: A structured result-to-action data workflow fits the founder's data-science, health-monitoring and automation strengths.
A secure-upload pilot avoids initial laboratory integration and physical sampling, keeping the first test within the founder's part-time and capital constraints.

A contracted competent water-safety professional must own interpretation, control decisions and escalation; the founder supplies workflow software and must not present himself as the qualified decision-maker.
Introductions through laboratories or consultants can reduce, but do not eliminate, the direct B2B selling burden that may be tiring for the founder.

redesign.economic_effect: The redesign removes an initial lab-portal connector and the need to monetize every routine sample, replacing the speculative 100000-sample path with paid activation of higher-value positive-to-retest cases and an optional recurring hotel-portfolio workflow. It can stage capital behind paid case contribution and obtain any reusable rights directly from operators, but price, margins, case frequency, renewal, rights and channel conversion all remain unvalidated.

risks: The workflow could create false reassurance or be mistaken for qualified advice; it must preserve raw accredited results, uncertainty, urgent escalation and the named competent expert's authority.
Lab-confirmed exceedance cases may be too infrequent, or hotel operators may decline to pay separately for coordination already provided by laboratories, consultants or facility systems.
Contracted expert review, support, insurance and secure handling may consume the case fee and prevent positive contribution.
Accredited laboratories, consultants or incumbent platforms can bundle the same positive-to-retest workflow and control referrals.
Explicit operator reuse rights may not be granted, and positive-to-retest cases may remain too sparse or heterogeneous even within hotels to support valid outcome baselines.
A secure-upload workflow reduces connector dependence but introduces manual intake, data-quality and operational-scaling risks.

structure.control_point: The operator-owned case record linking an accredited positive result, a competent expert's signed control plan, documented interventions and an accredited retest
structure.critical_dependency: A paid hotel pilot, competent-expert governance, explicit operator reuse rights and enough comparable positive-to-retest cases to improve hotel-specific templates

thesis: For multi-site hotels, turn each accredited Legionella exceedance into an expert-governed positive-result-to-accredited-retest case file: test whether the operator will pay for coordinated evidence and an audit-ready dossier, while only separately consented outcomes may improve hotel-specific templates and baselines.
title: Hotel Legionella Remediation Casebook
uncertainties: Whether a multi-site hotel operator will pay for case activation or an annual workflow beyond laboratory, consultant and facility-system services.
The frequency of qualifying positive-to-retest cases and the number of reachable hotel portfolios.
The case fee, subscription price, contracted-expert workload, support burden, insurance cost, contribution margin and payback.
Whether operators will grant reusable rights and whether enough comparable cases can support defensible hotel-specific outcome baselines.
Whether laboratories or consultants will make referrals without integration, exclusivity or margin commitments.
Controller and processor allocation, retention limits and the exact boundary between workflow support and regulated or qualified interpretation.
